steps.title: Check your own report. Which of them did you do?
steps.model: Recommending: You could try…ing · I’d (strongly) recommend… · It’s well worth…ing · If I were you, I’d… · You just have to…

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ describe a place — run-down, vibrant, trendy, open-air, skyline, destination
✓ use the have phrases — have a go, have a clue, have a feeling
✓ recommend at the right strength — from You could try… to You just have to…
✓ use -ing after could try , thought of and well worth
✓ ask for a recommendation, and accept one
✓ describe change — It used to be…, but now… / There’s been a big increase in…
